sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.birth_date > date('2026-09-24', '-26 years') AND c.birth_date <= date('2026-09-24', '-25 years');
